question: Does an intentionally factorized role-equivariant public-program representation enable the native CPU Hybrid to exploit a withheld PARITY+NEGATE composition that prior unfactored R98/R99 native models could not? Does separately added feedback derived ONLY from the realized factual consequence outperform the same factorizer without that feedback?

source.law: R85 pure physical world constructor, new independent four-factor A resampling and new original source salts, actual world law recomputed with R98 PURE law_of semantics; never R98/R99 original _world or any original scored cohorts. 224 physical ticks, original publicly selected 48x13 rows and lawful 5x13 A-role/pivot input.
source.public: Four observed noisy A factor cues with actual role IDs, public role selector/yes/no/distractor tags and public MUX/PARITY and NEGATE instructions in preaction probe observation channel8; chosen action and time observed. No hidden A factor signs, true law label, future observation, unchosen return or teacher parity labels supplied to any learner.
source.factual: One actually selected CALIBRATE or EXPLOIT_POS intervention and its realized 9-tick return per FIT/VALID world, index-only balanced across early/cold and programs; all fully trained arms observe identical input, action, actual reward and optimizer batches.
source.heldout: All nine? Actually eleven frozen arms fully trained before DEV_SEEN/DEV_COMPOSE/OOD_SHIFT/PROGRAM_SWITCH physical world first generated. Evaluation after parameters frozen, with physical evaluator-only paired returns.
source.shift: R86 pure timing/noise OOD shift, same heldout new composition, NOT unfamiliar physical law, full 224-step cold memory or new primitive.
source.program_change: On same new physical heldout world, operator PARITY+NEGATE changed to MUX+NEGATE, all A/B factors, noise, time and role tags preserved. Evaluator-only paired physical returns, report action changes conditional on actual changed hidden physical law.
source.outcome_aux: Auxiliary binary microfeedback target is 1{observed selected factual return>0} derived ONLY from the exact same actually observed return already used by main head, with both action/time public; no hidden physical law, parity teacher, alternate payoff or privileged labels. This approximate reward-sign proxy is NOT guaranteed equal to true law, and must not be called a ground-truth causal teacher.
source.return_shuffle: Fix seed-only zero-fixed-point cross-world assignment inside public pivot and actual chosen action groups WITHOUT reading reward/true-law. Shuffle ONLY the auxiliary observed return-sign target. Correct chosen actual reward remains used for main head. Postfixed private donor true-law match rates required [0.35,0.65], otherwise SOURCE_INVALID without adaptive resampling.
source.source_checks: Private true-law sign balance within each public pivot and factual action [0.35,0.65] on each panel; future leakage, original cohort access and source collisions fail closed.

architecture.native: Original unmodified authentic CPU R74 width32 HybridPilot_FULL with R75 triangular TTT, original SSM/causal attention/TTT/depth, unchanged official model.py; no GPU fusion.
architecture.factorized_algebra: EXPLICIT ENGINEERED OPERATOR PRIOR: shared learned per-A factor tanh calibration from legally observed noisy A cues; public role tags perform EXACT selector/yes/no canonical indexing; differentiable MUX uses selector sigmoid gate of chosen branch cues; PARITY is product of learned factor signs; public MUX/PARITY opcode selects branch; public negate bit multiplies result by -1. This supplied MUX/PARITY/NEGATE algebra is NOT learned new relation semantics or autonomous operator discovery.
architecture.internal: One learned scalar factorized law estimate, selected public action/time are projected into a width32 native STEM context added only at last legal pivot BEFORE existing native SSM/attention/TTT/depth and native original value head. All parameters trained from scratch on factual returns; native trunk must learn how to use structured latent for action value.
architecture.feedback: A single independent factual-sign head predicts approximate selected-return positivity from internal factorized law estimate and public chosen action/time; lambda=0.15 BCE auxiliary loss in addition to true chosen-return MSE, no extra source. Same initialized head and forward for NO_AUX, factual aux, and return-shuffled aux arms.
architecture.control: Opcode-mask same architecture/init but both public opcode bits masked BOTH in 14D features and original four native public instruction channels; main return remains factual; seed-only auxiliary target derangement arm preserves true main reward; original native and R98 unstructured role-program STEM internal comparator are full-step trained.
architecture.external: Same engineered factorizer and factual-observation access, but additive output value head on original native, to test whether improvement is native-specific vs any cheap explicit rule-aware head. No native superiority claim unless positive beats this externally provided equal-algebra control.
architecture.conventional: Fully trained original R98 14D raw MLP64, R98 role-set public program and R81 GRU64 5×13 public event rows, same action/reward minibatches. R98 ENGINEERED public-law canonical MLP upper supplied deterministic observable rule sign; never count as autonomous learned baseline.
